text:
Anna (People Ops): Quick heads-up — launching the "Bright Moment" token drop next Friday. Small physical tokens + snack table to hand out to folks who've been doing standout helpful things. Need volunteers and nominations. :sparkles:
Jana (HR): Love this. Are tokens tied to any formal spot-award budget or just culture-driven small treats?
Anna (People Ops): Mostly culture-first (under $25/token). We have a small budget for additional vouchers if teams want to convert tokens later. This is more about visibility.
Mike - Eng: How do nominations work? Can managers nominate peers?
Anna (People Ops): Anyone can nominate anyone. We'll surface a short form — 2 fields: name + 1-line reason. Planning to run it open for 72 hours.
Sam - UX: I can make a quick Google Form and a tiny landing page on Notion. Want copy for email and the poster.
Anna (People Ops): Yes please. Email copy: "Nominate a colleague for a Bright Moment — tell us a short example of when they made your day better or shipped a tiny win. We'll celebrate on Friday at 3pm with snacks + tokens." Keep it casual.
Olive (Facilities): For the snack table I need headcount for the 3–4pm window. Also need a table reservation and two volunteers to set up at 2:30pm.
Anna (People Ops): Volunteer shifts: setup 2:30–3:00, run table 3:00–4:00, teardown 4:00–4:20. Who can take which?
Mike - Eng: I can do teardown. Happy to help.
Sam - UX: I'll do setup and help with the poster + small sticker print. Can we get a tiny chalkboard sign that says "Bright Moments"?
Jana (HR): I'll double-check policy on recognition tokens (just in case). Also will approve the final form wording.
kudos-bot: Someone nominated Priya for helping unblock the data pipeline yesterday! :tada: (autonotice)
notes: volunteer coordination, nomination logistics, budget note
